skill: Read template-contract first. Assign the original template ID; readers receive the language version. get-template reports translation.originalId, translations, missingLanguages and editor ownership. Use translate-template to open/create a version, then get-template and save-template on that version. If the translation plugin owns editing, use its reported editor URL and do not bypass the refusal. Shared headers/footers have their own translations through translate-synced-pattern; place the original pattern ID in templates so each reader receives the correct language. Native content-slot attributes and other saved block markup must be preserved. Source rules are shared by the original and all translations in one JSON manifest. Changing contentSource from any manually editable version updates the whole group's choices without rewriting translated blocks or words. Never create per-language rules or duplicate PHP files. PHP choices come only from the active/parent theme templates/ directory.
